items.title: Courtland Sutton: Goes without catch in Week 11
items.text:
Sutton didn't corral either of his two targets during Sunday's 38-24 victory versus the Raiders.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Cam Skattebo: Works around another turnover
items.text:
Skattebo rushed 14 times for 34 yards and brought in three of seven targets for 14 yards in the Giants' 23-18 win over the Jaguars on Sunday. He also lost a fumble.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Bhayshul Tuten: Held in check by Giants
items.text:
Tuten rushed 10 times for 33 yards and brought in all three targets for 20 yards in the Jaguars' 23-18 loss to the Giants on Sunday.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Michael Mayer: Musters one reception in Week 11
items.text:
Mayer posted one catch (on four targets) for four yards during Sunday's 38-24 defeat at Denver.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Malik Nabers: Gets into end zone in upset win
items.text:
Nabers brought in seven of 12 targets for 55 yards and a touchdown in the Giants' 23-18 win over the Jaguars on Sunday.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Fernando Mendoza: First TD passes of career
items.text:
Mendoza was 18-for-37 passing for 267 yards, three touchdowns and one interception and had four carries for 22 yards during Sunday's 38-24 loss in Denver.

items.title: Parker Washington: Eclipses century mark in Week 11 win
items.text:
Washington secured eight of 17 targets for 103 yards in the Jaguars' 23-18 loss to the Giants on Sunday.
